verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents Rovo-powered AI capabilities built into the product: an AI code reviewer that reviews changes and suggests fixes, AI-powered pipeline workflows that can autonomously clean up feature flags, update docs, draft release notes, and fix flaky tests, and Rovo access from terminal/IDE — all pointing to delegable AI task execution within the product. However, this is entirely first-party marketing copy with no hands-on or independent corroboration of how well these AI delegation features actually work in practice, and Rovo terminal/IDE access suggests it may be a companion tool rather than fully embedded in Bitbucket's own UI. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of AI task delegation, clearer detail on how deeply Rovo is embedded vs. a separate tool, and community feedback on real-world reliability.
